'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 James Booker DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Booker]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
